module: Backend of the grid selector of the "Quickrace" Vue wizard: exposes the list of levels and, for each level, its list of tracks. The module contains no logic of its own: it creates a backend with ui/oneshotRaceSelector/core from the shared descriptor quickRaceTrackDescriptor (identifier "quickraceSelector") then copies all its functions into M.
notes: The functions actually exposed are those of createBackend (defined in ui/oneshotRaceSelector/core.lua); they are not visible in this file.
